channel.title: Long Beach Press-Telegram - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Beach Press-Telegram (presstelegram.com)

item.title: The LA coastline as a national park? A new study asks the public to consider the idea
item.description: Should the LA coastline, roughly from Will Rogers Beach to Torrance Beach, be a national park? You can give your feedback.

item.title: A California photographer is on a quest to photograph hundreds of native bees
item.description: Krystle Hickman has photographed over 300 types of bees native to North America.

item.title: Immigration officials plan to spend $38.3 billion to boost detention capacity to 92,000 beds
item.description: ICE plans 16 regional processing centers with a population of 1,000 to 1,500 detainees.

item.title: Lunar New Year: A look at the Year of the Horse
item.description: The Chinese New Year celebration starts with the new moon on the first day of the new year and ends on the full moon 15 days later.

item.title: Federal immigration enforcement agents demobilize staging area at Terminal Island
item.description: L.A. Council member Tim McOsker said, "In moments like this, we will take any good news we can get."

item.title: Veterans’ memorial plaques in Tustin stolen; Long Beach man arrested
item.description: Police say the suspect is linked to bronze plaque thefts at Veterans’ Sports Park in Tustin and other memorial sites across Orange County.

item.title: NBA All-Star Celebrity Game: Rome Flynn repeats as MVP, Team Giannis wins
item.description: The actor/model scores 17 points as Team Giannis beats Team Anthony, 65-58, in a game that brought basketball back to the Forum for the first time in years. Former NBA player Tacko Fall scores 20 points for the losing side.

item.title: 76ers’ VJ Edgecombe leads Team Vince to Rising Stars title, shares Abdul-Jabbar moment
item.description: The 20-year-old guard, who was named Rising Stars MVP after a 17-point semifinal effort and his game-winning free throws in the final, says meeting basketball icon Kareem Abdul-Jabbar is his All-Star Weekend highlight.

item.title: Warren boys basketball prevails in playoff battle with Long Beach Wilson
item.description: Warren holds on for the win in the second round of CIF-SS Division 3 as Wilson hurts its efforts with a few key mistakes at the end.

item.title: La Mirada boys basketball rallies to upset St. John Bosco in Open Division
item.description: La Mirada makes a third-quarter surge and then holds on late to beat St. John Bosco in the Open Division playoffs.
